thread:
Mia (CS): kicking off capacity bring-up run for Polaris this week. primary goals: quota validation, autoscale policy, and one full soak load test. ETA for cutover still Thu EOD?
Raj (Eng): can confirm GPUs are reserved for Thu morning. need final quota numbers from billing to seed the autoscaler.
Jenna (AM): flagged Polaris renewal as medium risk in QBR - want a smooth launch. customer asks for a 2-hour window with zero errors during peak.
Olivia (SRE): noted. I'll set up healthchecks and a fast-fail alert. suggest conservative autoscale to start (min=2, target=60% util) and then step to aggressive after soak.
Kai (Eng-Infra): infra ok but need to whitelist their IPs and add VPC routes. sending terraform diff in a sec.
Mia (CS): @Raj can you post the quota numbers when you have them? we need to configure `reserved_capacity` and `burst_margin`.
Raj (Eng): provisional quota: 12 reserved GPUs, burst up to 18 for 30m, but that's pending finance approval.
Jenna (AM): ok will escalate finance approval now. also scheduling customer enablement session Fri 10am for runbook walkthrough.
Olivia (SRE): load test plan: 1) warmup 20m 2) 2h soak at 70% expected qps 3) spike tests three times. will attach k6 script.
Raj (Eng): small config snippet for autoscaler (for ops team):

```
policy: gradient
min_replicas: 2
max_replicas: 20
scale_target_utilization: 0.6
burst_margin_ms: 300
```

Mia (CS): sounds good. also capturing feedback items: customer wants per-request latency breakdown, and a dashboard tile for token-cost by endpoint.
Kai (Eng-Infra): Terraform plan posted: https://redwood.internal/plans/1753 (ACL + routes). pls review.
LoadBot: load-test job #873 queued by Olivia. estimated run 02:15:00.
Olivia (SRE): kicked off a small canary now to validate routing, will report back within 15m.
Raj (Eng): quick note on fallback: plan a policy to fallback to hosted-small model when dedicated pool saturated. reduces latency risk for critical endpoints.
Jenna (AM): adding that fallback as a customer ask, will include in enablement slides.
Mia (CS): renewal angle: if bring-up completes with <1% error and meets latency SLO for 2 consecutive days, we mark health as green for renewal. capture that as milestone in the renewal tracker.
Olivia (SRE): Canary result: healthy, no 5xx, steady KV cache hit ~88%. scheduling full soak Thu 09:30 UTC.
Raj (Eng): updated quota: finance approved burst to 18 for first 48h. updating autoscale config.
Kai (Eng-Infra): IP whitelisting done, routes applied.
Mia (CS): perfect. planning doc link: https://docs.redwood.internal/cs/polaris-dedicated-onboard (notes + runbook).
Olivia (SRE): starting soak now. will stream logs to the runbook and ping on high latency threshold.
LoadBot: load-test job #873 started (soak).
Jenna (AM): scheduling post-soak readout Fri 11am with customer. aim to surface any adjustments and collect feedback on the enablement materials.
Mia (CS): checklist for closeout: 1) confirm 48h error rate 2) cost/projection review 3) update renewal tracker 4) collect customer feedback + NPS. assigning owners in the doc.
Raj (Eng): if we see sustained queueing we'll temporarily increase `burst_margin_ms` and add another replica. I'll be on-call Thu evening.
Olivia (SRE): soak at +90m: 0.6% errors, investigating two bad model checkpoints — rolling back one variant.
Mia (CS): capturing as a feedback item: preference for variant pinning controls in console. logging to product feedback board.
LoadBot: load-test job #873 completed. summary: avg latency 210ms, p95 560ms, error 0.6%, KV cache hit 86%. report uploaded.
Olivia (SRE): post-soak actions: reverted to stable variant, autoscaler scaled to 14 during peak and settled back to 3.
Jenna (AM): customer readout scheduled, they'll want a short exec note on what went wrong and how fixed. I'll draft it.
Mia (CS): thanks team — overall good run. next steps: finalize cost projection, close renewal action if metrics hold for 48h, and schedule a follow-up to iterate on autoscale policy. :tada:
